sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_fts" USING fts5(entity UNINDEXED, local_id UNINDEXED, title, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "original_name" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "due_time" TEXT NULL, "defer_until" TEXT NULL, "reminder_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "project_local_id" TEXT NULL, "area_local_id" TEXT NULL, "parent_local_id" TEXT NULL, "recurring_parent_uid" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_type" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_interval" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_end_date" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_weekday" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_weekdays" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_month_day" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_week_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "completion_based" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completion_based" IN (0, 1)), "today_move_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_blocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_blocked" IN (0, 1)), "status_before_done" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_tasks_ai AFTER INSERT ON tasks BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'task', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.note, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_tasks_au AFTER UPDATE ON tasks WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name OR old.note IS NOT new.note OR old.pending_delete IS NOT new.pending_delete BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'task' AND local_id = old.local_id;INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'task', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.note, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_tasks_ad AFTER DELETE ON tasks BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'task' AND local_id = old.local_id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "title" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "project_local_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_notes_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'note', new.local_id, coalesce(new.title, ''), coalesce(new.content, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_notes_au AFTER UPDATE ON notes WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.content IS NOT new.content OR old.pending_delete IS NOT new.pending_delete BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'note' AND local_id = old.local_id;INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'note', new.local_id, coalesce(new.title, ''), coalesce(new.content, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_notes_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'note' AND local_id = old.local_id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started', "priority" INTEGER NULL, "due_date_at" TEXT NULL, "area_local_id" TEXT NULL, "pin_to_sidebar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pin_to_sidebar" IN (0, 1)), "task_show_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("task_show_completed" IN (0, 1)), "task_sort_order" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created_at:desc', "image_url" TEXT NULL, "task_count" INTEGER NULL, "completed_task_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_projects_ai AFTER INSERT ON projects BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'project', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.description, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_projects_au AFTER UPDATE ON projects WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name OR old.description IS NOT new.description OR old.pending_delete IS NOT new.pending_delete BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'project' AND local_id = old.local_id;INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'project', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.description, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_projects_ad AFTER DELETE ON projects BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'project' AND local_id = old.local_id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "color" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));
CREATE TRIGGER search_tags_ai AFTER INSERT ON tags BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'tag', new.local_id, new.name, '' WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_tags_au AFTER UPDATE ON tags WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name OR old.pending_delete IS NOT new.pending_delete BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'tag' AND local_id = old.local_id;INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'tag', new.local_id, new.name, '' WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_tags_ad AFTER DELETE ON tags BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'tag' AND local_id = old.local_id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "areas" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NULL, "project_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_areas_ai AFTER INSERT ON areas BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'area', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.description, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_areas_au AFTER UPDATE ON areas WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name OR old.description IS NOT new.description OR old.pending_delete IS NOT new.pending_delete BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'area' AND local_id = old.local_id;INSERT INTO search_fts (entity, local_id, title, body) SELECT 'area', new.local_id, new.name, coalesce(new.description, '') WHERE new.pending_delete = 0;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_areas_ad AFTER DELETE ON areas BEGIN DELETE FROM search_fts WHERE entity = 'area' AND local_id = old.local_id;END
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_area ON projects (area_local_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_tags" ("note_local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_local_id", "tag_local_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_notes_project ON notes (project_local_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_note_tags_tag ON note_tags (tag_local_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("task_local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("task_local_id", "tag_local_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_due_date ON tasks (due_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status ON tasks (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_project ON tasks (project_local_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_parent ON tasks (parent_local_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_completed_at ON tasks (completed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_task_tags_tag ON task_tags (tag_local_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inbox_items" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "server_created_at" TEXT NULL, "server_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "local_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "base_json" TEXT NULL, "pending_delete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_delete" IN (0, 1)), "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'added', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "extra_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "not_before" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pull_cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_full_reconcile_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_inbox_status ON inbox_items (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_target ON outbox (entity, local_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_state ON outbox (state, not_before)
